name: 07-collect-oaks-parcel
objective: Walk into the Viridian Mart. The clerk hands over OAK'S PARCEL on your first visit with no prerequisite at all — the mart's own default script runs it — so entering the shop is the whole of this leg.
evidence: watch:got_oaks_parcel!=0 — EVENT_GOT_OAKS_PARCEL, event index 57, so wEventFlags $D74E bit 1, mask $02, walked out of pokered's constants/event_constants.asm const list. ViridianMartOaksParcelScript (scripts/ViridianMart.asm) reads `lb bc, OAKS_PARCEL, 1 / call GiveItem / SetEvent EVENT_GOT_OAKS_PARCEL` — the flag is set beside the call that puts the parcel in the bag, so the two cannot disagree and the flag is the stronger of the two to watch.

the leg really is 'walk in' — ViridianMartDefaultScript fires on entry with no CheckEvent guarding it, prints the clerk's line, and then walks the player to the counter itself with a simulated PAD_LEFT 1 / PAD_UP 2. So the solver needs no waypoint inside the shop, and the objective's claim is the script's own behaviour rather than an observation about one playthrough.

failure party_hp=0 — the same judgement as link 06, for the same reason: Viridian City has grass on its western edge and a blackout there is a real one (HandlePlayerBlackOut's OAKS_LAB early return needs OPP_RIVAL1), warping the player away with money halved.
